notes.title: Update Polish
notes.notes:
Working on the writing for the story in my current in progress game-making adventure, The Gods of Oxis, has gotten me thinking about a lot of things that I can improve very quickly with Space War Machine. I will be going back to this project very briefly, and I will be adding improvements to this game to make it friendlier and more accessible to all those who wish to play it.

I will be removing the experimental radar screen added from the last build that is mucking up the screen space. I will be restricting the camera movement to the top-down perspective and making a few more improvements throughout the game, to make it shine a bit more and be more friendly to new players.

Look for these improvements coming out very soon! I want to make the game more accessible to all, and that means fixing some things that stick out in my mind.

As always, I recommend using Xbox style controllers to play the game, although I now have other controller types as well to test and implement controls.

Please stay with me, and realize that this project, like my current game, is the product of one lone developer! It was based off former game concepts I had created in the 2d format all the way back from when I was using game maker pro while I was still in the military!

notes.title: Please make sure to turn on auto-update... Updates adding up to 1.42!!!

Please make sure to turn on auto-update, and I usually upload updates weekly.

-now you can steer ships! hold down the auto-find button to follow ships. If you press the move button, you can steer your current ships!

notes.title: Wormhole update with 1.39!!!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! I hope you are having a great day. I have been working hard on some game improvements and updates! The game has been updated to 1.39!!! 

Now the wormhole has been added to all systems. New wormhole script has been created! Simply fly your ships into the wormhole, and make sure to have some factories! Once you stay in the wormhole, your ships will jump into it and come out in a new system! You can do this infinitely. All objects are now correctly parented under masters and the room is wiped clean on warp. Finally the dreams of taking ships from one system to another is complete!

Mouse support has been activated again. Now the game will allow the selector to snap to the mouse when a player is clicking a mouse, and will snap to the center when the player is using a controller! Mouse and keyboard controls were in the game first, and have taken a backseat to controller development, but it has been enabled again!

Zoom IN/OUT Top-down mode has been disabled. Now the zoom zooms in and out rather than up and down.

Auto-fight has been updated! Now ships find the enemy that is closest to them instead of random enemies! This makes for a more efficient asteroid clearing and keeps ships together in small groups.

Player 1 and 2 now start farther apart. Scale with player 1 and 2 ships has been fixed.

The match timer now counts hours. The max population has been set back to 30. Fleet management is vital to the game, and you need to delete ships when you are at the max.

Low level ships have had their scale retouched, with level 1 ships being bigger and adjusted. Other small changes were made.

Now all ships are created by code, with no prefabs starting in the scene, with the player ships checking the players race when created. All ships in the game are created at the moment and from a template. Player races are now stored on the player resources script.

Stay tuned for future updates that add new content! Updates are added approx. weekly!
If you have suggestions or comments, please email me at Keith@HavronGlobal.com
of go to my twitter @ https://twitter.com/SpaceWarMachine
and check out my videos and game clips at: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQHihfm24fhUqjLP0tQOFkQ/videos

notes.title: 1.34 Changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In the 1.34 update we have a lot of improvements that help the original experience of playing with a mouse and keyboard. Please see below for a list:

-move the auto-fight button from middle mouse to the space bar. Now it wont conflict with the camera rotations anymore.
-crashing into or building too close to a planet no longer does damage to ships. Planet damages have been fixed to not damage ships so easily
-ships exploding after a while has been fixed. Now lvl 1 ships are fixed to not explode.
-auto-fight feature now only works on combat ships. Utility and factory ships now will no longer leave due to auto-fight feature activation
-Enemy building has now been spaced out putting more room in between building times
-added Find Ally and Find Enemy functions to the keyboard on Z and C keys on keyboard
-factory spawn points now moved behind factory ships. made to fly into planets and build behind
-fixed an issue where planets were not hurt by sonic and heat weapons. Now planets can be damaged by all types of weapons
-issue fixed where moons were creating blackholes when destroyed. Now they trigger the appropriate planet explosion
-increased the range on starstation weapons
-starstations no longer target asteroids/neutral creatures
-range of terraformers has been increased. From 5 to 15. This gives a much longer range for terraforming.
-factories now say "Max Units" when the population is maxed out, and not ready
-max units can now be increased! when creating a factory, get +5 population cap for a total of 60 max
-issue with growth scale not scaling life with max life has been fixed. Now life bar is full when all units are created
-the player now starts with deployed factories! You must terraform to create more though.
-each factory created will now give the player one free units of each type!
-the Learn how to Play section now has a diagram for keyboard and mouse commands!
-the Learn how to Play with controller and keyboard layouts can now be accessed from the pause menu in-game
-pausing game now brings the game down to slow with time control, while un-pausing brings the game back to normal
